description: This file defines the EntityServiceFactory class which provides static methods to retrieve LocalDispatcher and DispatchContext instances related to entity delegators within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: EntityServiceFactory
classes.description: Provides static factory methods for obtaining LocalDispatcher and DispatchContext instances based on Delegator objects.

methods.name: getLocalDispatcher
methods.description: Returns the LocalDispatcher associated with the given Delegator.

methods.name: getDispatchContext
methods.description: Returns the DispatchContext associated with the given Delegator via its LocalDispatcher.
